sources.entry: Gancio - Local community event and agenda sharing. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs

summary.name: Gancio
summary.one_liner: Gancio is a shared event agenda and community calendar for local communities, with ActivityPub (fediverse) support, hosted here on framagit.org.
use_cases: Run a shared agenda for a local community
Federate event listings with the fediverse
Self-host an event calendar for a town or collective
summary.what_it_does: The page is a GitLab repository view on framagit.org showing the Gancio project's git revision selector, with branches (for example main, master, alpha, and feature branches such as 661-recurring-events and 671-implement-resources-comments-incoming-from-fediverse) and tags up to v2.0.0-beta.8. The meta description describes Gancio as a shared agenda for local communities with ActivityPub support. Per the awesome-selfhosted listing, it is licensed AGPL-3.0 and written in Node.js, with a demo and source code available. The page text itself contains no feature documentation beyond branch and tag names.
notable: Listed in awesome-selfhosted under Polls and Events
caveats: Page text is only a repository branch/tag listing; features and setup are not described here
Platform support beyond Node.js and web is not stated on the page
